台.english: Taiwan (abbr.); surname Tai; (classical) you (in letters); variant of 臺|台[tai2]

更.english: to change or replace; to experience; one of the five two-hour periods into which the night was formerly divided; watch (e.g. of a sentry or guard); more; even more; further; still; still more

量.english: to measure; capacity; quantity; amount; to estimate; abbr. for 量詞|量词[liang4 ci2], classifier (in Chinese grammar); measure word

分.english: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to allocate; to distinguish (good and bad); (bound form) branch of (an organization); sub- (as in 分局[fen1 ju2]); fraction; one tenth (of certain units); unit of length equivalent to 0.33 cm; minute (unit of time); minute (angular measurement unit); a point (in sports or games); 0.01 yuan (unit of money); part; share; ingredient; component

搬.english: to move (i.e. relocate oneself); to move (sth relatively heavy or bulky); to shift; to copy indiscriminately

通.english: to go through; to know well; (suffix) expert; to connect; to communicate; open; to clear; classifier for letters, telegrams, phone calls etc; classifier for an activity, taken in its entirety (tirade of abuse, stint of music playing, bout of drinking etc)

推.english: to push; to cut; to refuse; to reject; to decline; to shirk (responsibility); to put off; to delay; to push forward; to nominate; to elect; massage

易.english: surname Yi; abbr. for 易經|易经[Yi4jing1], the Book of Changes; easy; amiable; to change; to exchange; prefix corresponding to the English adjective suffix "-able" or "-ible"

重.english: to repeat; repetition; again; re-; classifier: layer; heavy; serious; to attach importance to

停.english: to stop; to halt; to park (a car)
